headline: Nine campaigns, one audience, and a cost per order nobody could explain
leak: Spend had tripled in a year and orders had not. Nine campaigns were bidding against each other for the same two thousand people.
sub: The account was fragmented, not underfunded. Consolidating did more in three weeks than six months of creative testing.
steps: Twelve months of spend in one view.
miss: The first consolidation went too far and learning stalled for nine days. We reversed it.
